label: Listening 1 — Sam's family photo
lines: Listening one. Sam talks about a family photo. Write the ages.
Hi, I'm Sam, and this is a photo of my family. Here's my mother. She's forty-one.
My father is next to her. He's forty-five.
The little girl is my sister, Kate. She's eight.
And here's my grandmother. She's seventy-two.
Oh, and that tall boy at the back is my cousin, Oliver. He's fifteen.

label: Listening 2 — Have you got…?
lines: Listening two. Have you got…? Five children answer. True or false?
Leo, have you got a sister?
No, I haven't. But I've got two brothers.
And you, Mia? Have you got any cousins?
Yes, I have. One cousin. She lives in Spain.
Jack, have you got a pet?
Yes, a dog. His name's Rex.
Amy, tell me about your grandparents.
Well, they've got a small house near the sea.
Daniel, have you got a brother?
No, I haven't. I've only got a sister.

label: Listening 3 — A new student
lines: Listening three. Lucy, a new student, talks to her teacher. Listen and complete.
So, Lucy, tell me about your family. Have you got any brothers or sisters?
Yes, I've got one brother. His name's Jake.
What about your mum and dad?
My mum's a nurse, and my dad's a taxi driver.
My grandmother lives with us. She's eighty!
